title: jmap-client: port sse.rs and blob.rs
description: Port SSE parser and blob response type from crate-jmapchat-client into crate-jmap-client/src/sse.rs and src/blob.rs. Neither is a verbatim copy — both require removal of Chat-specific items.
design: For src/sse.rs: copy SseEvent, SseFrame, parse_sse_block BUT remove the SseEvent::Typing and SseEvent::Presence variants — these are JMAP Chat push events, not base JMAP SSE events. Keep only variants defined in RFC 8620 §7.3 (StateChange, RequestTooLarge, and any base-protocol push variants). For src/blob.rs: copy BlobUploadResponse but it is NOT verbatim — any reference to JmapChatClient must be renamed to JmapClient, and if it imports jmapchat_types::Id replace with jmap_types::Id.
